'''Eldon Ax''', born '''Cinzia Xandret''', was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] living around the time of the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Born the daughter of technician [[Lema Xandret]], she was separated from her family and trained in the [[Sith Academy]] under [[Darth Chratis]]. At the age of 17, she was confronted with her past, as evidence of her family's whereabouts, now considered a traitor to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Ax herself took over the search for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], which eventually led both the Sith Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to the planet [[Sebaddon]]. The two parties formed an alliance to destroy the [[Fastbreeder|hex droids]] made by Lema Xandret, who had the potential to depopulate the entire [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. As one of the leaders of the Empire, Ax encountered a [[Cinzia Xandret|clone of her own]], taking control of the droids that could kill their master and eventually disable them.

==Biography==
===Long-forgotten past===
Cinzia Xandret was stolen from her mother, a [[Droid/Legends|droid maker]] named [[Lema Xandret]], by Darth Chratis while she was still a child. Because Lema Xandret refused to willingly give up her child to the Sith, she was sentenced to death. Lema Xandret escaped the imposed death sentence by fleeing with some of her fellow droid makers. Darth Chratis imposed a Force powered mental block in Cinzia's mind to prevent her from recalling memories of her past, and renamed her Eldon Ax.<ref name="Fatal Alliance" />

===In the Sith Empire===
====The search for her mother====
After losing a battle against a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] named [[Dao Stryver]], Ax was interrogated by her, who looking for information on Lema Xandret and a ship named ''[[Cinzia]]''. It was later found that the remnants of the ship named ''Cinzia'' were found and were being auctioned off by a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] named [[Tassaa Bareesh]]. Prior to giving this information to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Dark Council]], Darth Chratis removed the memory block he imposed on Eldon Ax and told her the true story of her existence. Chratis and Ax were dispatched by the Dark Council to steal the remains of the Cinzia and execute Lema Xandret if she was found. During the attempt to steal the remnants of the ''Cinzia'', mysterious and deadly [[Fastbreeder|hex droids]] appeared and thwarted the theft. Although the attempt to steal the artifacts was unsuccessful, Ax was able to use the remains of a hex to trace their origin back to a planet called [[Sebaddon]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were also able to do the same. Ax then traveled with her master to claim the planet for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]].<ref name="Fatal Alliance" />

Upon arriving at Sebaddon, the hexes launched a deadly defense of the planet which severely damaged both the Republic and Imperial fleets. The two fleets brokered a truce and a temporary alliance to defeat the hex threat. To seal the deal, Chratis insisted that Ax accompany Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]], while he himself would take Shan's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Shigar Konshi]]. During the battle, Ax found a [[Cinzia Xandret|clone of herself]] that was being kept alive in a tank filled with amnioid fluid. Ax also found that her mother had been killed by her own Hex Droid creations, but continued to exist and speak to her clone through the amnioid fluid. Ax learned from her clone that the Hex Droids were created to protect her. Upon release from the amnioid tank, the clone immediately died, but not before instructing Ax to feed her [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] into the hex computer. The hexes recognized Ax as Cinzia and followed her commands. Eldon Ax eventually [[Death/Legends|killed]] her master Darth Chratis when she ordered hex droids to attack him during the [[Independent Operation Sebaddon|battle]] on Sebaddon. She then ordered them to destroy themselves. Later, she became the apprentice of [[Darth Howl]], a member of the Dark Council.<ref name="Fatal Alliance" />

==Personality and traits==
A cunning young woman, Ax managed to kill her own master and cover it up. Recognized by the Dark Council, she eventually became a full apprentice to Darth Howl, no small feat in the merciless ranks of the Sith Empire.<ref name="Fatal Alliance" />

When she had learned of her origins, Ax, with her loyalties to the Sith, wanted to see her mother dead for her betrayal and wasn't afraid to admit that to anyone, even the Jedi.<ref name="Fatal Alliance" />

==Powers and abilities==
Ax possessed a small ability for [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] and was a capable [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duelist]]. Despite her age, when concentrating her rage, Ax was also quite adept at using [[Force barrier/Legends|Force barrier]] to prevent herself from getting seriously damaged, though she could still be outnumbered and overwhelmed when numbers were against her or when she was distracted, like in her battles with the Mandalorian [[Dao Stryver]].<ref name="Fatal Alliance" />
